limit.reason: the docstring states the device converts phase into the -180,180 range

facts.text: The SR865 is a lock-in amplifier; the upstream class is described as 'SR865 Lock-In Amplifier'
The valid sensitivities are the 28 values of the sens array, from 1 V down to 1 nV
The valid time constants are the 22 values of the tau array, from 1 us up to 30 ks
set_tau rejects a value that is not exactly one of the tau array values
set_tau converts a valid time constant to its OFLT index with np.digitize(tau_constant, tau, right=True), so 1 us is index 0
set_sens rejects a value that is not exactly one of the sens array values
set_sens converts a valid sensitivity to its SCAL index with np.digitize(sensitivity, sens), so 1 V is index 0
The phase reference is in degrees; the device auto-converts it to the -180,180 range
The worker programs the three settings with 'OFLT {:d};SCAL {:d};PHAS {:.6f}'
The worker reads the three settings with 'OFLT?;SCAL?;PHAS?'
